allow-catalog-desktop-local-index.description: Allows Settings 本机数据 to open a blank-query category catalogue from the same Rust-owned safe search index across local workspaces. It records no search history and grants no body, filesystem, transport, credential, export or media access.

allow-clear-desktop-local-search-history.description: Allows clearing only normalized owner-local search history; it cannot clear conversations, index rows, or workspace content.

allow-desktop-account-sync.description: Allows explicit Google system-browser sign-in, safe account status readback, direct selected-conversation sync, an explicit cloud-list read, and changing only the account-owned cloud-list pin projection for an authenticated listed conversation. It grants no webview credential access, arbitrary endpoint, hidden account switching, local deletion or broad filesystem access.

allow-desktop-app-settings.description: Allows the native settings surface to read and revision-save only non-secret appearance and Android-parity preferences in Rust-owned SQLite. Runtime capability flags remain fail-closed; this grants no credential, notification, account, update, model, prompt, attachment, path or network access.

allow-desktop-compare.description: Allows only stopping an already-running historical Compare execution so partial content remains recoverable. New Compare submission and branch retry are intentionally unavailable; no arbitrary provider, model, URL, credential projection or automatic resend is exposed.

allow-desktop-conversation-draft-recover.description: Allows only the current ordinary Composer to read or replace its own workspace and conversation scoped local recovery draft, referencing existing private attachment IDs. It grants no attachment bytes, paths, transport, credentials, automatic send, history, or access to another workspace.

allow-desktop-conversation-read-state.description: Allows only opaque workspace/conversation read watermarks, manual unread marking, and true-open clearing in device-local SQLite. It grants no title, message body, prompt, attachment, path, credential, transport, export or account-sync access.

allow-desktop-domain-history.description: Allows persistent local undo, redo and recycle-bin projections.

allow-desktop-history-knowledge.description: Allows the opted-in low-frequency history-library owner to read content-free candidate projections, wake the fixed model route, explicitly retry UNKNOWN/failed work, and accept/reject/delete one candidate. It grants no arbitrary URL, credential projection, attachment/tool content, silent retry, direct Memory write, or Knowledge write before explicit acceptance.

allow-desktop-local-backup-restore.description: Allows only native-picker-selected .nfai-backup export, strict private-inbox preflight, explicit replacement restore, cancellation, and restart-status readback. It grants no arbitrary path discovery, credential export, network, merge, background retry, or silent continuation.

allow-desktop-model-service-settings.description: Allows the latest Android model-service settings contract: safe provider projections, revisioned local selection, system-Keychain credential save or explicit reveal, and an explicit fixed-endpoint connection probe. It grants no arbitrary URL, hidden credential read, background test, prompt, conversation or model invocation.

allow-desktop-ordinary-chat.description: Allows one user send or explicit retry to atomically persist an ordinary-chat Attempt and use only the fixed provider/model registry, scoped system credential, verified message attachments and bounded streaming transport. Stop and latest-attempt readback are conversation/Attempt scoped; no arbitrary URL, path, credential value, silent retry or raw payload is exposed.

allow-desktop-p6g-model-selection.description: Allows only revisioned local catalog candidates, global tier, one ordinary-conversation manual model override, conversation-local style/web-search preferences, and safe route metadata. It grants no API key, URL, request body, Prompt, HTTP, Provider invocation, cache body, export, filesystem or temporary-conversation access.

allow-desktop-privacy-cleanup.description: Allows Android-parity local cleanup only through an aggregate fingerprinted preview and one of three fixed scopes: explicitly selected terminal failed-task assets, deleted knowledge/memory trash, or all app-private business data with the exact confirmation phrase. It grants no arbitrary path, wildcard command, content projection, export, transport or provider invocation.

allow-desktop-reminders.description: Allows only reviewable reminder drafts, explicit confirm/reject/edit, persisted local schedules, runtime due execution through the existing fixed Provider transport and usage ledger, pause/resume/delete/retry, content-safe notification receipts and exact opaque-id routing. It grants no silent plan creation, arbitrary URL/model/credential/path access, notification permission bypass or UNKNOWN auto-resend.

allow-desktop-temporary-conversation.description: Allows only the isolated P6-E temporary recovery owner: local enter, draft/message update, native-picker or focused-Composer clipboard File attachment binding/removal, and irreversible clear. It grants no clipboard path or URI, normal Conversation, workspace, search, export, cache, credential, or transport command.

allow-desktop-transcription.description: Allows persistent workspace-scoped transcription tasks: native-picker-selected bounded media or JPG/PNG/PDF import into verified private attachments, explicit Qwen ASR or GLM-OCR execution on their fixed endpoint/model with the existing provider-scoped credential, cancel/retry/delete, and native-picker-selected verified exports. It grants no arbitrary URL, path projection, recording, pause, hidden background replay, SenseVoice execution, arbitrary OCR model, or credential projection.

allow-export-desktop-attachment-to-selec.description: Allows one explicit native-save-picker action to copy only a workspace-owned, hash-verified attachment to that selected absolute file and verify the written bytes. It grants no path discovery, arbitrary source read, directory export, transport, credential or automatic share access.

allow-export-desktop-workspace-to-select.description: Allows a typed workspace ID to export only to a user-selected .nfai-exchange path.

allow-import-desktop-conversation-attach.description: Allows only a user-mediated native-picker selection, focused-Composer clipboard File bytes, or a current-window PNG camera frame into the same private content-addressed owner; it grants no clipboard path or URI, arbitrary camera control, filesystem API, transport, or credential access.

allow-import-desktop-workspace-exchange-.description: Allows one user-selected exact .nfai-exchange or Android DocumentsUI .nfai-exchange.zip package to enter only the v2 strict-preflight/private-archive/single-transaction owner. It grants no path projection, arbitrary filesystem API, v1 staging, credential, transport, Provider or model access.

allow-import-staged-exchange-as-new-work.description: Allows a preflighted private staging ID to become one new isolated Desktop workspace.

allow-inspect-p8-agent-runs.description: Allows only read-only P8 ledger inspection metadata; it cannot plan, approve, execute, pause, resume, cancel, or invoke a tool.

allow-list-desktop-workspaces.description: Allows read-only workspace summaries from Rust-owned SQLite.

allow-mutate-desktop-domain.description: Allows only typed, revision-checked local P6-C domain intents through Rust SQLite.

allow-open-desktop-attachment-with-syste.description: Allows an explicit user gesture to open only a workspace-owned, hash-verified private attachment through the macOS system opener. The webview never receives its path and no arbitrary path is accepted.

allow-open-desktop-source-link.description: Allows an explicit user gesture to hand off a validated public HTTP or HTTPS source URL to the macOS system browser.

allow-p6e-temporary-maintenance-acceptan.description: Allows only the no-argument P6-E acceptance status and fixed owner-maintenance fixture. Rust rejects both unless the explicit acceptance environment marker selected the isolated /tmp app-private root.

allow-p6h-chatgpt-export-import.description: Allows only the P6-H ChatGPT conversations.json adapter task: user-selected private copy, inert bounded candidate projection, explicit per-item confirm/skip/cancel/retry, and task recovery. It grants no arbitrary filesystem read, path projection, credential, transport, Provider or model invocation access.

allow-p6i-claude-export-import.description: Allows only the P6-I Claude conversations.json adapter task: user-selected private copy, inert bounded candidate projection, explicit per-item confirm/skip/cancel/retry, and task recovery. It grants no arbitrary filesystem read, path projection, credential, transport, Provider or model invocation access.

allow-p6j-nanfeng-knowledge-export-impor.description: Allows only the P6-J user-selected 南枫知识库完整 JSON adapter task: private copy, inert static chat candidate projection, explicit per-item confirm/skip/retry, and task recovery. It grants no arbitrary filesystem read, credential, transport, Provider, model or tool invocation access.

allow-p6k-zip-import.description: Allows only P6-K user-selected ChatGPT or Claude ZIP imports: private staging, bounded strict adapter, receipt-backed direct commit, recovery, and soft-delete. It grants no arbitrary filesystem read, credential, transport, Provider, model or tool invocation access.

allow-permanently-delete-desktop-convers.description: Allows only an exact workspace-owned recycle-bin conversation ID and revision to be permanently removed with its full-snapshot history and last-reference private assets. It grants no bulk wildcard, arbitrary filesystem path, restore, credential, transport or provider access.

allow-read-desktop-archive-preview.description: Allows only a workspace-owned, hash-verified ZIP attachment ID to return a bounded safe directory projection and one explicitly selected safe relative entry as inert text, image pixels, or PDF page pixels. It grants no path, extraction, executable content, transport, or arbitrary file read.

allow-read-desktop-audio-preview.description: Allows only a workspace-owned verified audio attachment ID and local resume position; no path, URI, transport, or arbitrary file read is granted.

allow-read-desktop-background-runtime.description: Allows reading only the content-free macOS background wake-up status. It grants no LaunchAgent mutation, arbitrary command, path, prompt, conversation body, credential, provider payload, or network access.

allow-read-desktop-c16-visual-acceptance.description: Allows only the validated C16 appearance, font and layer tuple selected by the diagnostic-only isolated acceptance gate. Normal startup returns no tuple; this grants no path, environment, data, credential, provider or network access.

allow-read-desktop-image-preview.description: Allows a workspace-owned image attachment ID to produce verified local thumbnail or user-requested original display bytes; no path, URI or arbitrary file read is granted.

allow-read-desktop-local-search-history.description: Allows read-only projection of normalized owner-local search history.

allow-read-desktop-pdf-preview.description: Allows only a workspace-owned PDF attachment ID and 1-based page to produce an owner-verified inert local display payload; no path, URI, text extraction, script action, transport or arbitrary file read is granted.

allow-read-desktop-privacy-inventory.description: Allows only aggregate counts and byte totals across local workspaces, messages, attachments and private import packages for Settings 本机数据. It grants no content, names, paths, credentials, deletion, export or provider access.

allow-read-desktop-runtime-info.description: Allows only the current packaged application version, operating-system family and CPU architecture to be shown in About. It grants no path, environment, device identifier, credential or network access.

allow-read-desktop-search-attachment-pre.description: Allows only a workspace-owned, hash-verified attachment ID to return one bounded inert search-card preview: PDF first-page pixels, UTF-8 text excerpt, or audio duration. It grants no path, media payload, playback, script, transport, export, or arbitrary file read.

allow-read-desktop-text-preview.description: Allows only a workspace-owned verified text attachment ID to return bounded inert UTF-8 text; no path, URI, HTML, script, transport, or arbitrary file read is granted.

allow-read-desktop-usage-ledger.description: Allows only a safe read projection of final measured token and amount facts from the local append-only Usage Ledger. It grants no prompt, response, credential, attachment, path, mutation or provider access.

allow-read-desktop-video-preview.description: Allows only a workspace-owned MP4 attachment ID and an optional bounded playback position to produce owner-verified metadata and a private range-readable media URL; no path, transport, decoder control, or arbitrary file read is granted.

allow-read-desktop-video-thumbnail.description: Allows only a workspace-owned, hash-verified MP4 attachment ID to return one bounded raster poster frame; no video payload, path, URI, decoder control, or arbitrary file read is granted.

allow-read-desktop-workspace.description: Allows one typed workspace ID to be projected from Rust-owned SQLite.

allow-read-dual-path-status.description: Allows read-only dual-path configuration status; it cannot read credentials, create a transport, or write sync state.

allow-reexport-desktop-workspace-exchang.description: Allows listing committed private v2 exchange records and re-exporting exactly one UI-selected committed v2 owner only to a native-save-picker-selected .nfai-exchange target. It grants no v1 workspace, path projection, arbitrary filesystem API, credential, transport, Provider or model access.

allow-save-desktop-audio-preview-positio.description: Allows only a workspace-owned verified audio attachment ID and its local resume position to be recorded; it returns no audio bytes, path, URI, transport, or arbitrary file read.

allow-save-desktop-video-preview-positio.description: Allows only a workspace-owned verified MP4 attachment ID and its local resume position to be recorded; it returns no video bytes, path, URI, transport, or arbitrary file read.

allow-search-desktop-local-index.description: Allows one normalized local query to read the Rust-owned safe search index and records history only for an explicit submitted query. It grants no filesystem, transport, credential, export, or media access.

allow-share-desktop-attachment.description: Allows an explicit preview action to present the native macOS share picker for one workspace-owned, hash-verified attachment; no file path or bytes are returned to the renderer.

allow-stage-preflight-selected-exchange.description: Allows only a user-selected .nfai-exchange file to be bounded and copied into private app data staging.

allow-upsert-desktop-model-metadata.description: Allows typed local-only safe provider/model metadata; no credentials or network catalog.

allow-write-desktop-markdown-to-selected.description: Allows only bounded visible conversation Markdown to be atomically written to one native-save-picker-selected absolute .md path and read back for hash verification. It grants no arbitrary read, directory traversal, attachment bytes, credential or network access.
